name: boomerang-notifier
description: Get instant phone alerts when Cursor or VS Code AI output finishes via multi-channel push services and webhooks.

boomerang.pushChannel.default: Webhook 通道（企业微信/钉钉/飞书/Discord/Custom Webhook）
enum: Webhook 通道（企业微信/钉钉/飞书/Discord/Custom Webhook）

boomerang.targetValue.markdownDescription:
目标凭证 (Target Value)。

**注意**：VS Code 不支持根据上方选项动态修改此处的说明文本，但当您切换上方 `pushChannel` 时，本输入框的**内容会自动填充**对应平台的示例格式。

**常见格式说明**：
- **大多数通道**：直接填入 Token / Key。
- **Webhook**：填入 URL。若开启了安全关键词，使用 `|` 拼接，如 `https://...|Boomerang`
- **WxPusher**：`AT_xxx/UID_xxx` (凭证/用户ID)
- **Telegram**：`bot_token/chat_id`

boomerang.notificationTemplate.markdownDescription: Custom notification text. Supports `{source}` placeholder. Leave empty to use built-in humorous and friendly messages.

boomerang.slowNotificationTemplate.markdownDescription: Custom text for slow-response alert. Triggered when chat logs include `taking longer than expected`. Supports `{source}` placeholder.
